name: Pamphylia
line: Pamphylia was a coastal region in southern Asia Minor where Paul and Barnabas preached on their first journey and where John Mark left the team.

moments.title: John leaves at Perga
moments.text: Paul and his friends sailed from Paphos to Perga in Pamphylia. There John left them and went back to Jerusalem.

moments.title: Preaching in Perga
moments.text: After passing through Pisidia, Paul and Barnabas came to Pamphylia and spoke the word in Perga. Then they went down to Attalia and sailed to Antioch.
